actionAdapters.entry: confirmed Luban source, business UIView source and UI registration source

配置已确认的 Luban Project、导出描述和运行时加载描述时
导出已冻结的 ProjectId、DescriptionId 与 all/code/data 范围时
已确认表已接入当前项目的运行时加载链时

actionAdapters.entry: Unity Editor/MCP Prefab and existing navigation binding
actionAdapters.when: 用户已确认 Unity 写入范围和入口行为时
UI注册源和已保存UISettings已冻结；全量scope=all/code/data，单文件sourcePath仅code/data；使用Plan/Execute/编译后Verify

actionAdapters.entry: Nova.UI.OpenUIViewSync<T> / OpenUIViewAsync<T> / OpenUIViewSync(string uiViewName, object userData = null) / OpenUIViewAsync(string uiViewName, object userData = null) / OpenUIViewByAssetSync / OpenUIViewByAssetAsync
actionAdapters.when: 在已授权业务源码接入中按类型、UI表Name或唯一AssetLocation选择配置；所有打开先加载UI注册表，分组、暂停与池化以表为准，缺失或歧义返回-1；旧bool重载仅供迁移且不再覆盖表格

inputs.name: viewName
inputs.constraint: 先从实际项目发现View/Prefab/注册与入口；已有走nova-project-update-ui-view，只页面缺失且授权创建才走nova-project-ui-create-view，二选一执行，不重复注册。

inputs.name: sourceCellEdits
inputs.constraint: 仅用户同时要求表源调整时传递：原标量为source/sourceHash/sourceRoots/generatedRoots及1至256个已有非敏感单元格/唯一rowKey/key/column/type/beforeValue/value；严格table-fields追加为唯一自描述xlsx/SchemaHash映射、全部原键、普通类型/注释及明确default或全键values，相邻空列最多8192新格。不插删行、不改外部Schema/行键/公式/宏/复杂类型；追加字段必须同描述scope=all和编译后再UI绑定；纯页面绑定或既有表复核不要求此分支。

allow: confirmed Luban schema and data source
confirmed TableComponent settings through Unity Editor or MCP
confirmed table code and data output for the selected export description
generated UI output for this registration
UI Action planned shared UITables, _configs and exact owned stale/counterpart deletions

confirmed Luban schema through its dedicated editor; existing project-owned xlsx/csv non-sensitive scalar cells or strict table-fields append-only ordinary fields in self-described xlsx through shared nova_table_source.py
project-local Library/Nova/AgentActions/TableSource/ request, registry snapshot, plan, receipt and owned backup JSON
deny: manual edits to generated table or UI output
unrelated Luban project, export description, table output or Config export
unrelated UI registration, navigation or generated output
manual edits to generated UI output
manual edits to generated table output
unrelated Luban project, export description or output
macro/formula modification, row insertion/deletion, duplicate key cells, arbitrary source/generated boundaries or secret/identity field edits through the generic source CLI

requiredFor: ambiguous table source, schema, ProjectId, DescriptionId, output, DataTarget or Asset address
ambiguous row selection, field mapping, UIGroup, registration source, asset path or entry behavior
create or change a table schema, source or runtime load description
delete, external write, credential use, Git commit or push
confirmation.rule: Workflow 权限等于子 Operation 权限并集，确认门取最高等级，不因编排扩大授权。 UI导出确认绑定Action PlanId及展示的共享配置、UITables和删除范围。 可选sourceCellEdits继承Table Operation现有标量或严格table-fields分支的精确源/Schema/生成边界、输入hash、一次性计划和文件锁；仅用户明确要求该表修改时执行，普通字段追加正式代码+数据导出/编译先于UI绑定，未经该分支授权不修改表源。 requires仅登记可能的复用闭包；当前View存在选择update，缺失且授权创建选择create，不执行未选分支。

精确表导出结果、UI 导出和 Unity 编译
